name: RC-B10-0371/2025 – Recital F – Am 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text: F. whereas the detentions have been condemned across the political spectrum, including by prominent Turkish Cypriots and stresses that Türkiye’s refusal to recognise the Republic of Cyprus and its ongoing occupation remains a major obstacle in EU-Turkey relations;
